A.label: Enter
A.description: Confirm the current prompt or send the current choice.

B.label: Esc
B.description: Cancel, close a picker, or back out of the current UI.

X.label: Dictation
X.description: Toggle macOS Dictation using the configured shortcut.

Y.label: Down + Enter
Y.description: Select the next option, useful for yes / auto-edit prompts.
